createnetherindustry.ponder.tag.nether_i: Build your production lines in the Nether
createnetherindustry.ponder.condenser.te: The Condenser is a kinetic component that can transform fluids.
Input fluids from below, output products from above.
You can also customize fluid transformation recipes via datapacks.
recipe.createnetherindustry.soul_strippi: Place a Mechanical Fan behind the Soul Stripping medium.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.soul_item_: Soul fragments occasionally stripped during Soul Stripping.
Seems to contain an unusual power.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.medium.lin: Air blown through it seems to gain the power to strip souls.
Right-click with an empty hand to clear all negative effects. Heals undead mobs while harming others. Nearby undead are faintly attracted to it.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.blaze_twig: A blaze creation imbued with life.
Can only be planted on Crimson Nylium Farmland, made by using a hoe on Crimson Nylium and irrigating with lava. Yields Blaze Fruit when mature.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.ancient_me: A masterpiece of ancient Piglin mechanics.
Traces of it can still be found in ruins once inhabited by Piglins.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.soul_blaze: A golden pickaxe imbued with the power of souls and blaze.
Overflowing with blaze energy, it doesn't lose durability in the Nether, and its mining speed is doubled there.
A golden axe imbued with the power of souls and blaze.
Overflowing with blaze energy, it doesn't lose durability in the Nether, its breaking speed is doubled, and it deals double damage there.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.golden_car: Can now be planted on any Nylium Farmland.
Use a hoe on any Nylium and irrigate with lava.
jei.createnetherindustry.info.wither_ros: Can now be planted on Warped Nylium Farmland.
Use a hoe on Warped Nylium and irrigate with lava. Mix with Skeleton Skulls to obtain Wither Skeleton Skulls.
